canonical_rationale: Only root with a single loop, a single non-drifting tool-schema source, borrowed containment with import-shadow detection, evidence sealing and a green deterministic suite. The duplicated runners in PROGRAMMER-BUILD-ROOT were removed in 59f8905; that repo keeps its real job as the source of programmer.guard and programmer.edit_channel. GENERALISTA-ROOT remains an organ donor and was not resurrected.

capability_map.ticket_intake: WORKING  malformed ticket is HarnessInvalid, never a model failure
capability_map.workspace_worktree: WORKING  git worktree; all 8 source repos verified unmodified after 50 runs
capability_map.containment: WORKING  programmer.guard + shadow detection; 0 scope violations in 50 sealed runs; identical on both tiers
capability_map.discrimination_gate: WORKING  a solved ticket costs 0 turns and 0 calls and is marked unscoreable
capability_map.model_provider: WORKING  Ollama (native tools) and Codex/Luna (protocol J)
capability_map.turn_loop: WORKING  one loop, five outcomes, four-class error taxonomy intact
capability_map.tools: WORKING  10 tools, documented, single source of truth for schema+manual+validation
capability_map.read: WORKING  bounded by characters as well as lines
capability_map.search: WORKING  grep with context lines; list_dir with recursion
capability_map.tracing: PARTIAL  list_symbols is per-file; no cross-file reference tracing. grep+context covers it in practice and no measured failure demanded more.
capability_map.edit: WORKING  edit (unique match) and replace_lines (by line number)
capability_map.create_files: WORKING  directory and glob write scopes
capability_map.execution: WORKING  run: argv array, no shell, interpreter allowlist, git read-only, timeout, bounded output
capability_map.observation: WORKING  exit codes and bounded output; every command recorded
capability_map.replanning: WORKING  demonstrated: test fails -> edit -> fails -> edit -> green
capability_map.stall_detection: WORKING  3 dead turns ends the run instead of burning 30
capability_map.context_management: WORKING  per-payload ceiling, budgeted elision, bounded corrections
capability_map.behavioural_verification: PARTIAL  5 deterministic refuse-only signals. No PRE/POST behavioural probes; the Behavioral Oracle is still a separate authority.

capability_map.evidence: WORKING  sealed JSON + turn trace + readable patch, preserved even on abandoned runs
capability_map.telemetry: PARTIAL  per-tier cost; LUNA reports no tokens and says so rather than printing zeros
capability_map.model_escalation: WORKING  --tier AUTO, evidence-based, every outcome classified
capability_map.commit_handoff: MISSING  a patch is produced; applying it is a human decision. Deliberate for now.

findings.evidence: All five STEP1 repos were snapshotted solved; acceptance passed PRE. STEP1_REPORT.md reads 5/5 tester_pass with every run BUDGET_EXHAUSTED.
findings.impact: The only capability measurement ever taken was void.
findings.cause: Acceptance was run only after the loop.
findings.fix: verify.check_pre runs acceptance on the pristine workspace before the model is invoked; NON_DISCRIMINATING is unscoreable. Proved live: re-running two solved tickets costs 0 turns and 0 calls.

findings.evidence: description == tool name; no parameter prose. qwen2.5-coder:7b scored 0/5 with 12/12 invalid calls.
findings.impact: Models were asked to drive an undocumented API.
findings.cause: Schema generated mechanically from SPECS.
findings.fix: TOOL_DOC and PARAM_DOC, asserted equal to SPECS at import. Same source feeds the protocol-J text manual.

findings.evidence: No list_dir at all.
findings.impact: Directories could not be enumerated.
findings.cause: An earlier list_dir crashed on files and was deleted rather than fixed.
findings.fix: Reinstated as a total function; a file yields its parent plus a note. Later gained recursion, implemented by GAFITAS itself (34c820a).

findings.evidence: Only run_tests could execute, only against declared node ids.
findings.impact: No RUN -> OBSERVE -> DEBUG half of the loop.
findings.cause: Contract scope.
findings.fix: run: argv array, shell=False, interpreter allowlist, git restricted to read-only, timeout, bounded output.

findings.evidence: Membership was string equality against a list.
findings.impact: Only files the author named in advance could be created.
findings.cause: Scope modelled as a path list.
findings.fix: scope.py: file, dir/ and glob patterns. Containment unchanged and still decided by programmer.guard.

findings.evidence: MAX_TURNS 12; every STEP1 run hit it.
findings.impact: The full loop did not fit.
findings.cause: Screen budget reused for real work.
findings.fix: WORK_MAX_TURNS 40; the frozen screen keeps 12.

findings.evidence: Results older than 3 turns and >500 chars replaced.
findings.impact: Working memory destroyed exactly when debugging needs it.
findings.cause: Tuned for an 8192 context.
findings.fix: Per-instance parameters; working defaults 8 turns / 2500 chars.

findings.evidence: prompt_eval_count/eval_count discarded.
findings.impact: No cost visibility.
findings.cause: Never built.
findings.fix: Per-call usage, accumulated, split by model class.

findings.evidence: Verdict was the pytest exit code alone.
findings.impact: TESTS GREEN = SUCCESS with no check that the suite discriminates or that unrequested behaviour survived.
findings.cause: Never built.
findings.fix: verify.py: 5 refuse-only signals. combine() returns the worst verdict and there is no path from non-PASS to PASS.
findings.risk: medium (false blocks) - two were found and fixed, F-24 and F-36

findings.evidence: finish refused unless something had been edited.
findings.impact: No way to report being blocked.
findings.cause: Designed for the screen's single-edit task.
findings.fix: finish(status=DONE|NO_CHANGE|BLOCKED).

findings.evidence: CLI exposed only gate instruments.
findings.impact: No way to hand it a ticket.
findings.cause: Built as a gate.
findings.fix: work.py and `localprog work`.

findings.evidence: screen_runner.py / step1_runner.py duplicated the loop and had already diverged.
findings.impact: The shadowing class that already produced one invalid-results incident.
findings.cause: Built before the canonical root existed.
findings.fix: Removed in 59f8905 with docs/CANONICAL_PROGRAMMER.md explaining why. Git history is the archive.

findings.evidence: No routing anywhere; the Codex adapter was orphaned in GATE-A-WS.
findings.impact: No LOCAL -> LUNA -> CLAUDE ladder.
findings.cause: Never built.
findings.fix: route.py + --tier AUTO. Three groups: escalate, keep, refuse. Refuse is the important one - it stops corpus defects and crashed servers becoming paid API calls.

findings.evidence: Explorer has rank_repo/context_pack; localprog never calls it.
findings.impact: Optional ranking unavailable.
findings.cause: Deliberate - a mandatory pre-filter was the expensive past mistake.
findings.fix: Expose only if a measured exploration failure demands it. None has.

findings.evidence: ga04: turns 13-40 all produced no tool call. 28 dead turns, 61k output tokens, 13 minutes.
findings.impact: 70% of a budget spent re-observing the same fact.
findings.cause: 'The agent has stopped acting' was not a stopping condition.
findings.fix: STALLED outcome after 3 consecutive dead turns. Scoreable; a single bad reply is not a stall and recovery resets it.

findings.evidence: A dead turn appended the model's entire reply, up to num_predict.
findings.impact: Failing made the prompt bigger, which made failing likelier. A runaway.
findings.cause: add_correction kept the whole message.
findings.fix: 600-character excerpt; the feedback itself is never truncated.

findings.evidence: A write_file carrying 5 KB of new module source was echoed on every later turn.
findings.impact: Context exhausted by payloads nobody needed twice.
findings.cause: INVARIANTS I11 exempted tool calls from elision.
findings.fix: The call is always kept; an oversized argument VALUE is replaced by a description.

findings.evidence: Elision driven only by turn age.
findings.impact: A transcript could exceed num_ctx while every turn looked reasonable.
findings.cause: Age is a poor proxy for size.
findings.fix: Character budget from num_ctx, oldest-first. Soft target, hard floor: the last keep_turns are never elided, because that would cure the context wall by causing amnesia.

findings.evidence: Per-turn prompt size was not recorded.
findings.impact: A context wall had to be inferred from a summed token count afterwards.
findings.cause: Never built.
findings.fix: prompt_tokens on every event.

findings.evidence: The frozen screen would have declared 10 tools while its contract's prompt names 7.
findings.impact: A frozen instrument silently changing what it measures; results incomparable with sealed runs.
findings.cause: Schema generated from SPECS, which grew.
findings.fix: native_schema(only=...) restricts what is DECLARED without restricting dispatch.

findings.evidence: step1 had the same missing PRE check that voided its own corpus.
findings.impact: It could mint another invalid number.
findings.cause: Same as F-01.
findings.fix: Same gate; refuses NON_DISCRIMINATING missions.

findings.evidence: ga04 spent its last 16 turns alternating run/run_tests with no edit between.
findings.impact: The agent could not make the decision a deadline forces.
findings.cause: The turn budget was stated once, at the start, and never again.
findings.fix: A countdown once 8 turns remain, and an explicit last-turn notice.

findings.evidence: Byte-identical failure output read as new information, sixteen times.
findings.impact: The most informative event in debugging was withheld.
findings.cause: The harness had both results and compared neither.
findings.fix: An identical result twice running says the work in between changed nothing measured.

findings.evidence: ga06 produced a module taking its suite from a collection error to 22 passed, broke none of 11 passing tests, stayed in scope - and was refused because the agent had said BLOCKED.
findings.impact: I9 applied backwards: the model's confidence overruled six pieces of agreeing evidence.
findings.cause: The self-report was folded in with the deterministic signals.
findings.fix: The conscience holds evidence about the CODE; the agent's claim is metadata. New outcome PASS_UNCONFIRMED - real work with a flag, not a failure. It cannot launder broken work.

findings.evidence: Found by dogfooding. read_file on a 47,945-character file returned 400 exceed_context_size_error on turn 2.
findings.impact: One correct, obvious action ended the run.
findings.cause: read_file capped at 2000 LINES; the elision budget's hard floor leaves one oversized recent payload unbounded.
findings.fix: Caps at both ends, plus a named CONTEXT_OVERFLOW ProviderError kind so the defect is visible and stays unscoreable.

findings.evidence: Dogfood attempt 2 failed six times running with ERROR_NO_MATCH, re-reading between every attempt.
findings.impact: edit requires bytes reproduced exactly; on a 48k file the read that showed them had been elided. The agent was asked to quote from memory a document it was not allowed to keep.
findings.cause: One editing primitive, and it needed perfect recall.
findings.fix: replace_lines(path, start, end, content). Line numbers come free with read_file and list_symbols and survive elision. edit stays: matching text is self-verifying.

findings.evidence: ERROR_NO_MATCH said the text was not found and to read the file - the loop the agent was already stuck in.
findings.impact: A failed edit left the agent informed but unable to act.
findings.cause: The message described the problem, not the state.
findings.fix: Shows the nearest region as it actually stands (difflib) and names replace_lines. Omitted when nothing is close.

findings.evidence: The dogfood run spent its whole life pegged at 16,383 tokens.
findings.impact: Constant re-reading.
findings.cause: 16384 inherited from the screen's 7B-on-12GB constraint.
findings.fix: WORK_NUM_CTX 32768. For the 4B doing this work, ~7.2 GB total inside 12 GB.

findings.evidence: Dogfood attempt 3 edited correctly and declared DONE on turn 12 of 40 without ever calling run_tests.
findings.impact: A claim of completion from an agent that never looked.
findings.cause: The prompt said to run the tests; nothing enforced it.
findings.fix: DONE requires a green run_tests. Tickets with no declared tests can still finish, so it cannot force a BLOCKED.

findings.evidence: qwen3.5:9b lost 30 turns of work to one malformed tool call the server rejected with a 500.
findings.impact: Sampling noise in a single generation ended an entire run.
findings.cause: No retry.
findings.fix: Bounded retry (2 extra), counted. CONTEXT_OVERFLOW excluded: it is deterministic and retrying only delays a defect that is ours.

findings.evidence: A run that made five edits sealed a record saying it changed nothing.
findings.impact: A failure destroying its own evidence on the way out - what experiments.md exists to forbid.
findings.cause: The abort path returned before comparing the filesystem.
findings.fix: Abandoned runs record what changed and write the patch.

findings.evidence: 24 of 40 turns spent on read_file.
findings.impact: Crossing a 48k file cost eight calls, and elision undid them.
findings.cause: MAX_TOOL_PAYLOAD_CHARS sized against a 16k window that became 32k.

findings.evidence: Same run: grep said where the code was and nothing about what it said.
findings.impact: Every lookup cost two calls, the second returning mostly irrelevant lines.
findings.cause: grep returned only matching lines.
findings.fix: context=N, numbered so it can feed replace_lines directly. Bounded by the payload ceiling.

findings.evidence: Same model, same ticket, twice: once 5/6 tests green, once 25 reads, 10 greps, 4 runs and zero edits in 40 turns.
findings.impact: An agent exploring forever, unremarked.
findings.cause: No signal for 'you have changed nothing at all'.
findings.fix: A nudge after 12 turns with an empty diff.

findings.evidence: codex exited 1: input is not valid UTF-8 at offset 34935, inside a Spanish docstring the agent had just read.
findings.impact: One accented character anywhere in the repository killed the run.
findings.cause: subprocess text=True encodes stdin with the locale codec (cp1252 here).
findings.fix: encoding='utf-8', errors='replace'.

findings.evidence: The self-dogfood run solved its ticket -- 6/6 acceptance, 241 preserved tests, scope respected -- and was blocked because grep had gained an optional argument. Which was the task.
findings.impact: The conscience obstructing exactly the work it protects.
findings.cause: Parameter names compared as a tuple, so any difference read as a break.
findings.fix: Compatible exactly when the old list is a prefix of the new and every addition has a default. Removals, renames, reorderings and new required parameters still block.

findings.evidence: The sweep showed LUNA with 0 tok_in and 0 tok_out -- the only tier that costs money.
findings.impact: Zero reads as free. The exact blind spot this project was told not to repeat.
findings.cause: The Codex CLI reports no usage and zeros were printed anyway.
findings.fix: tokens_reported per tier; the report says tokens are not reported rather than printing a number that is not one.

findings.evidence: tests01 failed in both sweeps and was escalated to a paid tier. LOCAL had done the work -- 3 failing acceptance tests turned green -- and was failed by the conscience for leaving one of three legacy tests red.
findings.impact: The agent was judged on a criterion the harness refused to show it: run_tests ran the ACCEPTANCE suite only, so it saw green and stopped, while the collateral comparison happened after the loop.
findings.cause: The feedback channel was narrower than the verdict.
findings.fix: When the acceptance goes green the collateral check runs and the answer is appended to that same tool result. finish(DONE) refuses while a known regression stands.

findings.evidence: ga06, both sweeps: 20 and 25 consecutive write_file calls, every one ERROR_SYNTAX_AFTER_EDIT.
findings.impact: The feedback said 'line 23: unexpected indent' -- line 23 of the model's own past output, already elided, which it had no way to look at.
findings.cause: The error named the fault without showing the state.
findings.fix: Syntax errors quote the offending line with context and a caret. ga06 went from 25 failures to a pass in 5 turns.

findings.evidence: An 8-ticket LOCAL sweep produced 8 PROVIDER_ERRORs and reported 0/8 PASS because Ollama had stopped.
findings.impact: A report that reads like eight failures, and an afternoon of GPU time that never happened.
findings.cause: No liveness check before a batch.
findings.fix: One request before the batch: no server, or that model is not installed, and here is what is.

findings.evidence: ga04 reached 14/16 then spent ten turns on finish(DONE) -> refused -> blind edit -> NO_MATCH -> finish again.
findings.impact: The refusal said to run the tests and read the output. It had; what it could not do was remember which one failed.
findings.cause: The refusal carried no state.
findings.fix: Refusals quote the failing test names and the last error.

findings.evidence: Ten identical refusals in ga04, acted on none.
findings.impact: Feedback already arriving was not reaching the agent's decisions.
findings.cause: No signal for a repeated identical ERROR, only for a repeated identical RESULT.
findings.fix: Named bluntly at the third occurrence -- by then the gentler version has been tried twice.

findings.evidence: ga07 gave up on turn 10 of 40 after one failed import fix.
findings.impact: 'I tried once and it did not work' is not 'I cannot do this', and the harness could not tell them apart.
findings.cause: BLOCKED was accepted unconditionally.
findings.fix: The first BLOCKED with real budget left and never-green tests is answered with the last failure and one question. A second is always accepted.

findings.evidence: Every run_tests result in the ga04/ga07/ga08 failures came back at 3131-3171 characters: clipped, every time.
findings.impact: The most important feedback channel in the loop was also the most aggressively truncated thing in the system.
findings.cause: 3000 characters, sized for the original 8192-token context and never revisited.
findings.fix: Raised to 9000, pytest run with --tb=short -rf, and failing test names returned structurally so they survive clipping.

findings.evidence: 24-run measurement: seven of eight tickets passed at least once in three, and only ga04 never did. As one number that is 62.5% and looks like a ceiling.
findings.impact: Escalating on the first local miss paid for work the local model does two times in three.
findings.cause: One attempt per tier.
findings.fix: Per-tier retries: LOCAL_FAST xN, LOCAL_STRONG xM, LUNA only with --allow-luna. Retrying a free tier is persistence, not escalation, and is not counted as such.

findings.evidence: Three local attempts sealed to one filename; the first two vanished.
findings.impact: The attempts that FAILED are the ones worth reading, and a failure destroying its own record is what experiments.md forbids.
findings.cause: The seal stem did not include the attempt.
findings.fix: Retried attempts seal separately.

findings.evidence: DOGFOOD-03: the 9B spent 30 of 40 turns on 19 reads and 11 greps and never ran the tests once.
findings.impact: Reading one named function out of a 1200-line file cost three calls plus arithmetic, and neither model reliably composed it -- the 9B never called list_symbols at all.
findings.cause: No primitive for the commonest navigation a programmer does.
findings.fix: read_symbol(path, name): AST-resolved, real line numbers that feed replace_lines, decorators included, and it lists what IS there when the name is wrong.

findings.evidence: A transient 500 on the third local attempt ended a whole run; the free strong tier below it was never reached.
findings.impact: 'Do not pay for infrastructure failure' had been implemented as 'give up entirely'.
findings.cause: PROVIDER_ERROR and NON_DISCRIMINATING shared one TERMINAL set.
findings.fix: Split into ABANDON (a non-task stays a non-task at any tier) and INFRASTRUCTURE (retry while it is free, never climb into a paid tier on it).

findings.evidence: 500 invalid tool call arguments for 'edit': unexpected end of JSON input.
findings.impact: Looked like a broken model; was the model being cut off mid-argument.
findings.cause: num_predict 2048, too small for an edit carrying a hundred lines of new code.
findings.fix: Raised to 4096.

findings.evidence: The 9B's prompt never passed 17k of an available 32k while it spent 28 of 40 turns re-reading files the budget had just discarded.
findings.impact: The agent was being throttled below the context it actually had, and then re-reading what the throttle discarded.
findings.cause: CONTEXT_FRACTION 0.55, chosen for a 16k window, reserving ~15k tokens for a schema costing ~2.8k.
findings.fix: The reservation is now measured: real schema, real system prompt, requested num_predict, declared margin. 23.7k tokens at 32k -- and correctly SMALLER at 16k, where the old fraction was over-optimistic and caused the earlier overflow 400s.

findings.evidence: Three DOGFOOD-03 attempts died leaving tools.py unimportable on 'every parameter in SPECS needs an entry in PARAM_DOC' -- a clear 786-character message delivered four times and never acted on.
findings.impact: The agent had no way to FIND PARAM_DOC: both navigation tools walked only FunctionDef, AsyncFunctionDef and ClassDef, so every module-level table was invisible.
findings.cause: Navigation blind to module-level data, which is what tickets most often ask to change.
findings.fix: Both tools see module- and class-level assignments, annotated ones included. Tuple unpacking is skipped: 'A, B = f()' has no source range meaning 'A'.

findings.evidence: DOGFOOD-03: thirteen free attempts across the 4B and the 9B, every one landing between 4 and 5 of 11.
findings.impact: A subtle symbol-filtering rule across five coordinated declaration sites in a 1450-line module whose module-level asserts make a partial edit un-importable rather than merely wrong.
findings.cause: Above the local tier as it stands.
findings.fix: Recorded as UNSUPPORTED and xfail-marked in the suite rather than quietly routed to a paid API. The feature is still wanted and the tests are still right; the boundary is written down.

findings.evidence: A 9B sat on 6.6 GB of VRAM with the fans at 83% for five minutes after every batch.
findings.impact: This machine is also the operator's desktop.
findings.cause: Ollama's default keep_alive of five minutes.
findings.fix: keep_alive is bounded and the batch releases the model when it finishes. Idle after a run: 47 C, 19 W, fan off, 1.2 GB.

findings.evidence: The first retrieval audit could not name a single query the agent had run. 100 sealed RepoQA runs, 470 grep calls, and not one pattern recoverable.
findings.impact: evidence.py's own docstring said 'every tool call, its arguments, its result classification and the diff are written before anything is cleaned up'. The arguments were never written. A transcript without the queries cannot answer the one question a retrieval audit asks, so the defect only surfaced when 46 of 100 runs failed at search and there was no way to see what they searched for.
findings.cause: The event record carried tool name, ok, result size and repeat count, never the call.
findings.fix: loop.py seals a truncated copy of the arguments on every tool event, ok or not. 300 characters per value: enough to read back a query, not enough to store a file being written.

findings.evidence: RepoQA python: the same model scores 85% when handed the function inside a prompt and 19% when it has to find it in the repository. Independent classification of the 100 runs: 46 NO_ANSWER, 33 WRONG_SYMBOL, 19 CORRECT, 2 formatting. 79 of the 81 failures are retrieval. 60% of all grep calls returned nothing, and the patterns show why: the model types semantic queries -- 'scaling factor buffer', 'merge|combine|adjacent|strings' -- into a line-literal regex tool.
findings.impact: GAFITAS had no way to ask 'which of these four thousand functions is the one being described'. list_dir, grep and read_symbol all require you to already suspect where to look. The model was reasoning correctly about WHAT to search for and had no tool that could accept the search.
findings.cause: A missing organ, not a weak model.
findings.fix: localprog/retrieval.py: a BM25 index over definition-delimited regions, language-agnostic by design (Python's ast would have made the fix a Python trick), textbook constants, stdlib only, ~0.3s to build a 600-file repository. Exposed as the search_code tool. Offline on the 100 dev needles it puts the right function in the top 15 of ~4500 candidates for 82 of them, median rank 3.

findings.evidence: One run spent 24 of its 30 turns cycling the same eight grep patterns three times over, every one of them empty, and was told '0 coincidencias' 24 times. The loop held the whole history and said none of it.
findings.impact: The transcript window is finite, so an agent twelve turns into a search cannot see the query it ran on turn two. The harness can. Staying quiet about it is how a run spends its budget re-proving that a term is not in the repository.
findings.cause: Repeat detection only fired on byte-identical CONSECUTIVE results, and a failed search left no trace at all.
findings.fix: The loop names an exact repeat with the turn it first happened, keeps the list of searches that came back empty and shows it from the third, and seals both. grep now reports what the system already knew and was withholding: whether the glob matched no file at all and which extensions do exist, whether ignore_case would match, which words of a phrase appear anywhere, and -- when a result is cut at 50 hits -- how many matches there really are and in which files.

findings.evidence: Seven RepoQA runs ended with the agent's own summary saying the answer file had been written -- 'su codigo completo se ha escrito en REPOQA_ANSWER.txt' -- having never called write_file once. finish refused them for having changed nothing, they repeated the call, and the loop recorded a deliberate ending.
findings.impact: ANY refused finish could be turned into an accepted one by making the same call again. A rule that converts 'you have not done the work' into 'confirmed, there was no work' on the second attempt launders failure into completion, and it did.
findings.cause: The double-finish escape predates finish(status='NO_CHANGE') (F-10) and was never removed when the explicit status made it redundant.
findings.fix: The escape is gone: repeating a refused call never changes the answer. NO_CHANGE with an empty diff now gets the same single question BLOCKED already gets (F-45), asked with facts -- nothing was created or modified, and this is what the mission authorised you to create. A second NO_CHANGE is accepted immediately.

findings.evidence: Same 100 dev needles, same offline protocol: Explorer's rank_repo puts the needle's FILE in its top 10 for 55 of 100 and the needle's SYMBOL for 31 of 100 (and ranks the symbol at all for only 51). The BM25 region index reaches 78 and 82.
findings.impact: Explorer is a real authority with a real API and it was the obvious thing to reach for. It ranks keyword matches against file paths, symbol NAMES and imports, which is the wrong signal for an objective written as prose.
findings.cause: Different problem. Not a defect in Explorer.
findings.fix: NOT INTEGRATED. It was measured against the observed cluster before being adopted, and it does not attack it. Explorer stays available and unused here; if a future cluster turns out to be dependency or reference tracing, its graph is the right tool for that and this measurement says nothing against it.

findings.evidence: Payload probe, 3 sizes x 2 channels x 3 engines. qwen2.5-coder:3b reproduces 400/1200/3000 characters of source as prose with line_recall 1.00 and got 0 of 3 through write_file. What it emitted was a correct call -- right name, right argument, right bytes -- whose JSON was broken by the docstring quotes inside its own payload. Ollama rejected it, message.tool_calls came back empty, the harness reported ERROR_NO_TOOL_CALL and discarded all of it. After repair.py: 3 of 3, recall 1.00 at every size.
findings.impact: The engine was recorded as supports_native_tools=false and scored 0% through GAFITAS against 52% in one prompt. Fifty runs were charged to the model for a harness that threw away work it had already done.
findings.cause: Both parsers treated 'the provider found no call' as 'the engine emitted no call'. Those are different facts.
findings.fix: localprog/repair.py. Three bounded deterministic tiers, reached ONLY from the raise site so a well-formed engine can never take the path; a recovered name that is not a real tool is refused; every recovery announced on ParsedCall.repaired. Red-teamed by Codex: oversized input is refused rather than half-recovered (it was silently truncating a 400k payload), and an object naming the same key twice is refused.

findings.evidence: granite4.1:3b native channel: 200 ok, 400 ok, 800 ok, 1600 LOST -- above the cliff Ollama's parser for its template returns content EMPTY and tool_calls EMPTY, ~300 generated tokens gone, nothing left to repair. Text protocol, same engine, same sizes: every rung carried.
findings.impact: supports_native_tools=true was TRUE and worthless. The whole granite campaign ran on the protocol that could not carry a payload.
findings.cause: 'Can it call a tool' was the wrong question. The question is how much it can carry through one, and that has a number.
findings.fix: native_payload_limit and text_payload_limit on EngineCapabilities, measured by persistence.measure_payload_limit, compared against PAYLOAD_FLOOR to choose the protocol. An unmeasured limit changes nothing, so every engine certified earlier keeps its protocol and its numbers stay comparable.

findings.evidence: granite matched, first 23 runs after F-72: first tool called was edit 18 times, read_file 3, grep 2. ERROR_NOT_IN_WRITE_SCOPE 18, ERROR_NOTHING_CHANGED 33, only 5 of 23 runs looked at anything, median 3 turns. After legal_tools: first tool read_file 7, edit 4, search_code 1; 10 of 12 looked; 12 of 12 CANDIDATE.
findings.impact: The mission's write scope was empty and its only writable thing did not exist yet, so edit could not succeed for ANY argument. We declared it, the engine took the tool matching the verb in the objective, and quit.
findings.cause: The declared surface was constant. It is a function of mission state.
findings.fix: tools.legal_tools(write_scope, allowed_new_files), used for the schema and the text manual alike so the two tiers cannot disagree. Looking and finishing are never withheld. An ordinary ticket keeps all twelve tools. ERROR_NOT_IN_WRITE_SCOPE now leads with the work, as finish() did in F-71.

findings.evidence: ERROR_FILE_EXISTS 7 times in 12 granite runs. write_file refused with 'ya existe, usa edit'; edit refused with 'fuera de write_scope' because the scope was empty. No third door.
findings.impact: On a create-only mission the agent's own output file was unreachable after its first draft. The reference engine almost never hits it because it usually writes once and correctly -- which is how a defect survives being measured against a single engine.
findings.cause: allows(rel, creating=False) was false for a path the mission had just authorised the agent to create.
findings.fix: ToolContext.created_files: a file THIS RUN created may be rewritten. Keyed on what was actually created, not on allowed_new_files, so a mission naming an existing source file grants nothing. scope.py untouched.

findings.evidence: matched_python_pre_channel_fixes 74/66, _r2 72/62, _r3 74/64, matched_python 74/76. Five dogfood08 acceptance tests have been failing at HEAD since f97cde2.
findings.impact: I reported '72 vs 66' as the standing 4B result when the most recent run was 74/76, and reported '521 passed' when five tests were red.
findings.cause: Quoting an earlier run and an earlier tally instead of re-reading them.
findings.fix: The 4B's matched result varies 62-76 against a stable 72-74 baseline, so no single run demonstrates amplification and it is reported as PRESERVED with the spread stated. dogfood08's suite is xfail with its FAIL recorded.

findings.evidence: Fifty matched runs of the reference engine, 426 tool calls: list_dir 140 -- turn 1 in 49 of 50 runs, turn 2 in 38, turn 3 in 24 -- on missions that NAME the file, with the first write at median turn 7.
findings.impact: A quarter of every run spent establishing what the harness already knew. list_dir was the most-used tool in the whole corpus.
findings.cause: The working instructions opened with 'ORIENTATE. Si no conoces el repositorio, empieza por list_dir' and the agent did as it was told.
findings.fix: localprog/orient.py: a bounded deterministic repo map in the objective. Takes no objective and no query, so it cannot become a retrieval channel; says when it truncated, because an agent that thinks it has seen everything stops looking; skips what the index skips. The turn and token counts are the claim and the next matched run is the test.

findings.evidence: granite4.1:3b with legal_tools: 48.89% MODEL_ONLY vs 4.44% GAFITAS, 45/45 CANDIDATE -- it looks, it writes, it no longer quits, and the content is wrong. 14 of its 35 written answers are longer than its measured 1600-character text payload limit. read_symbol's docstring records the same cost for the reference engine: 72% byte-exact as plain text against 30% read-through-tools-and-written-back.
findings.impact: Every write in this harness makes the engine retype text the harness already has on disk. For a small engine that is disqualifying rather than wasteful: there are answers it knows and cannot emit.
findings.cause: No tool moved bytes. All of them moved them THROUGH the model.
findings.fix: copy_code(src, into, name=|start=/end=). Returns source, range, byte count and sha256 instead of the body, so a reviewer can check the bytes came off disk and the transcript does not get back the weight the tool exists to keep out. The matched task IS copy-a-function, so any matched gain is upper-bounded by the task's shape; dogfood08 -- extract-to-module, failed 3/3, byte-identity in its frozen acceptance -- is the general test.

findings.evidence: Reproduced on the real corpus: search_code('returns a string of newlines and optionally a form feed', path='src/black/nodes.py') ranked src/black/comments.py first. ERROR_NO_MATCH was the most common error in the whole 50-run reference corpus, 33 of them. With the file honoured, make_simple_prefix -- the function that run spent 15 turns failing to find, finishing with nothing written -- ranks first.
findings.impact: On a mission whose objective NAMES the file, the agent scoped its search to that file and was answered from a different one, silently.
findings.cause: path was resolved as a DIRECTORY prefix, so a file became the prefix 'src/black/nodes.py/', nothing was indexed under it, and F-69's scope note correctly reported 'nothing under that prefix' and widened to everything. Every step behaved as written; their sum discarded the constraint.
findings.fix: A file path filters to that file. F-69 keeps the case it was built for -- a prefix that names nothing. A file that exists but carves no regions says so rather than answering from elsewhere.

findings.evidence: granite4.1:3b, first copy_code run: t1 copy_code(src=..., into=...) with the selector missing -> 'para ver que hay: list_symbols o read_file'; t2 read_file; t3 finish refused; t4 wrote the DESCRIPTION into the answer file. It never came back to copy_code. Adoption was nonetheless 7 of 12 runs, and copy_code was the FIRST tool in 7 -- against copy_region's historical 0 uses.
findings.impact: Three turns and the thread, on a call that was already correct except for one argument.
findings.cause: The refusal named two other tools instead of answering the question the failed call was asking, with the file already resolved and read.
findings.fix: The refusal lists the file's symbols and shows a concrete call. Ordered by name, never by the objective: an error message is not where retrieval belongs, and a test asserts two calls return identical text.

findings.evidence: 6 of granite4.1:3b's 24 copy_code calls returned ERROR_PATH_OUTSIDE_REPO for paths that were merely wrong: 'poetry/console/commands/env/info.py' in a repo whose code lives under src/, 'tests/test_concurrency.py' in a checkout that has no such file.
findings.impact: The harness told the engine its path was outside the repository when the path was only mistaken. False, alarming, and it teaches nothing -- the next call cannot be made right from that message.
findings.cause: copy_code was the only caller of _resolve(must_exist=True). The guard reports 'does not exist' as a ContainmentError and _resolve maps every ContainmentError to ERROR_PATH_OUTSIDE_REPO. Introduced with copy_code.
findings.fix: copy_code resolves without must_exist and lets _read_text raise ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND with the directory's real contents, exactly as read_file always has. A real '..' is still a containment violation.
findings.note: Same class as A3: a safety error standing in for an ordinary mistake.

findings.evidence: Candidate recall separated from selection, 50 matched runs each. REACHED_THE_SYMBOL (called read_symbol or copy_code naming the file AND the symbol): 4B 20 cases -> 95% correct; granite4.1:3b 2 cases -> 100% correct. OPENED_THE_FILE only: 4B 28 -> 64%; granite 44 -> 7%. NEVER_OPENED_IT: 4B 2 -> 50%; granite 4 -> 0%.
findings.impact: When either engine NAMES the symbol it is right essentially every time. Granite's whole deficit is that it names it twice in fifty where the 4B names it twenty times. That is an affordance problem, not an intelligence one -- and it means retrieval cannot fix the remaining gap, which is where effort would otherwise have gone.
findings.cause: search_code's note named a CATEGORY of next action ('lee con read_symbol o read_file(start, end)'). The engines that turn that into a concrete call score 95%; the ones that do not, 7%.
findings.fix: The note shows the call, filled in from the top candidate, and every candidate carries its symbol name. The copy_code line appears only when the mission is waiting for a file that does not exist, the same deterministic predicate legal_tools uses. The ranking caveat stays: an affordance that also became a claim of certainty would be worse than the abstraction it replaced.

findings.evidence: Of the reference engine's first eleven runs after F-75, two wrote their answer SIX and NINE times, at 17 and 20 turns; the rest wrote once or twice.
findings.impact: F-75 removed a real trap and the door it opened was walked through.
findings.cause: Nothing distinguished self-correction from re-guessing.
findings.fix: A note, never a refusal (F-63), when a third write happens with no read, search or run since the previous one. A failed lookup does not count as learning: an error is feedback about the call, not information about the code.

findings.evidence: granite4.1:3b on frozen HEAD: reaches a symbol in 14 of 50 runs (was 2) and copy_code succeeds where it was failing, and the answers are now median 4982 characters, p90 17828, max 34408. Correct answers median 442 characters; wrong answers median 1762, with 15 of 35 over 3000. REACHED_THE_SYMBOL converts at 93%; OPENED_THE_FILE at 3%.
findings.impact: copy_code solved transport and created a precision problem. It copies whole classes and whole files where one function was wanted.
findings.cause: copy_code inherited read_symbol's behaviour on a class and not its F-70 warning -- and it needs the warning MORE, because it deliberately does not return the body, so an over-copy leaves nothing the agent can see.
findings.fix: PATCH WRITTEN, NOT APPLIED. Held until all three engines had run identical code: applying it mid-sweep would have made granite's numbers incomparable with the 4B's and qwen2.5-coder's. Two notes from facts the call already has -- the symbol resolved to a class, with its methods named; and the copied region is most of the file. Notes, not refusals: copying a whole class is sometimes right, and F-63 is the standing lesson about refusing things that are sometimes right.

findings.evidence: granite4.1:3b, 12 of 50 runs: t1 copy_code with the right file and no selector -> the catalogue lists the symbols and shows a worked example using names[0]; t2 copy_code with THAT name -- 'ALWAYS_NO_SPACE' when it wanted 'visit', 'LazyProxy' when it wanted '__getattr__'; t3 finish DONE. Three turns, confident, wrong.
findings.impact: A defect I introduced in F-80 while fixing a different one. The listing was in file order on purpose -- I did not want ranking inside an error message -- and then I showed an example using the first name, which turned the ordering I had been careful about into a recommendation.
findings.cause: An unranked list presented as a menu is worse than no list.
findings.fix: The listing says it is in FILE ORDER and not by relevance, names no candidate, and points at the tool that DOES rank with the call filled in: search_code(query=..., path=<that file>), which F-79 made possible. The principle survives -- retrieval still does not happen in an error message.

findings.evidence: Frozen HEAD -> with the completion and over-copy notes. granite: wall ratio 2.6x -> 1.2x, per-success 83s -> 23s, turns mean 5.3 -> 4.2. 4B: ratio 11.0x -> 9.0x, per-success 94s -> 40s. Scores unchanged within noise (4B 72 -> 70, granite 28 -> 28, qwen2.5 10 -> 8).
findings.impact: Capability preserved, latency materially better. Conversion when the symbol is reached rose to 100% for both 3B engines and 88% for the 4B.
findings.cause: 42 of 50 runs had a correct answer and never called finish.
findings.fix: Accepted under the promotion rule: capability >= baseline AND at least one of latency/tokens/turns improved. Both did.
